messages.description: Connection allowed by access control policy
messages.regex: AC_RuleAction: Allow, .*SrcIP: (?P<src_ip>[\d.]+), DstIP: (?P<dst_ip>[\d.]+), SrcPort: (?P<src_port>\d+), DstPort: (?P<dst_port>\d+), Protocol: (?P<protocol>\w+)

messages.description: Connection blocked by access control policy
messages.regex: AC_RuleAction: Block, .*SrcIP: (?P<src_ip>[\d.]+), DstIP: (?P<dst_ip>[\d.]+), SrcPort: (?P<src_port>\d+), DstPort: (?P<dst_port>\d+), Protocol: (?P<protocol>\w+)
AAA user authentication Successful : server = (?P<auth_server>[\d.]+) : user = (?P<user>\S+)
